title: Maximum Subarray (Code War Chain)
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, length of array.
Line 2: n space-separated integers.
Line 3: integer K (length requirement or divisor).
Line 4: integer T (target sum).
outputFormat: A single integer, the answer for the current stage.

examples.explanation: For Stage 1: The contiguous subarray [4,-1,2,1] has the largest sum = 6.

stages.title: Stage 1 - Maximum Subarray Sum
stages.statement: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum. (Kadane's Algorithm). Ignore `K` and `T`.

stages.title: Stage 2 - Max Circular Subarray Sum
stages.statement: The array wraps around (the last element connects to the first). Find the largest circular subarray sum. Ignore `K` and `T`.

stages.title: Stage 3 - Subarray of Length Exactly K
stages.statement: Find the maximum subarray sum of length **exactly** `K`. Ignore `T`.

stages.title: Stage 4 - Subarray of Length At Least K
stages.statement: Find the maximum subarray sum of length **at least** `K`. Ignore `T`.

stages.title: Stage 5 - Subarray Sum Equals Target
stages.statement: Count the number of contiguous subarrays that sum to exactly `T`. Ignore `K`.

stages.title: Stage 6 - Subarray Sum Divisible by K
stages.statement: Count the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by `K`. Ignore `T`.
